name: Hotel Artemide
summary: A hotel in a 19th-century building on Via Nazionale, between Termini and the historic center.
description: Hotel Artemide is at Via Nazionale 22, on the shopping street that runs from near Termini toward the center of Rome. The property describes a 19th-century building, a short walk from Repubblica metro, with the Colosseum, Forum, and Trevi Fountain reachable on foot or by a brief metro ride. Lina lists it for that combination of a dressed-up room and a practical pin on the map. The rate printed here is the Basic Double Room Booking.com showed for two adults on 10–11 November 2026.
facts: Set in a 19th-century building, per the property description
